description.value: Cypress Creek Lodge is the main base lodge at Cypress Mountain resort, perched high above West Vancouver at the end of the steep Cypress Bowl Road climb. The lodge houses the Gold Medal Cafe (light breakfast, coffee and tea) and the Cypress Creek Grill food court, plus the Big Bear Sports retail store and resort guest services. For touring cyclists who have made the demanding ascent to Cypress Mountain, it serves as a natural rest stop with food, shelter, and sweeping views of the North Shore.

address.value: 6000 Cypress Bowl Road, West Vancouver, BC V7V 3N9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names 'Cypress Creek Lodge' as a restaurant, but the website confirms it is the main base lodge building at Cypress Mountain resort (6000 Cypress Bowl Road, West Vancouver), housing multiple dining outlets including the Gold Medal Cafe (first floor) and the Cypress Creek Grill food court (second floor, closed for summer), plus retail and guest services. The resort is confirmed open for summer operations. No mention of bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, charging) appears anywhere in the website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cypress Creek Lodge is a real, open, publicly accessible base lodge at a major regional resort, offering food and services to anyone who makes the climb up Cypress Bowl Road — a well-known cycling destination.

Gold Medal Cafe and Crazy Raven Bar & Grill appear to be the primary active summer dining options in the lodge. No cyclist-specific amenity information is available from the website.
